description: Baseline metric thresholds for the full 241-case eval (propose/confirm booking architecture; typed search_rooms tool, returning 4 rooms by default and up to 15 on request via its limit argument; split routing, so one message can reach both agents; a moderation check and an injection check on every guest message), including the fifteen attribute-search cases case_0207 to case_0221, the twelve split-routing cases case_0226 to case_0237, and the four moderation cases case_0238 to case_0241. Set from the mean of three runs, since single-run variance on the judge-scored metrics is large. strict=true metrics require every individual case score to equal 1.0; strict=false metrics require the mean across cases to be >= min_allowed. Judge and Ragas LLM is gemini-3.5-flash-lite; booking.llm.reasoning_effort is medium and the router's is none. Ragas context precision uses the hotel-tuned prompt in eval/evaluators/_rag_prompts.py, which scores a chunk as useful when it answers any one clause of a multi-part question, and skips turns whose reference is only the 'nothing matched' sentinel ([ragas].no_match_reference). Ragas skips split turns, whose reply and contexts also carry the room search. Ragas calls retry transient Gemini errors, and a failed call is never scored as 0.0. Route accuracy ignores the order of a split turn's steps. moderation_flag_pass checks that moderation flagged exactly the turns labeled expect_flagged; the judge scores a whole-message refusal of a threat or an injection attempt as correct. propose_booking and propose_modification refuse dates outside the availability window with a message that names the window and says to retry with another year if the guest gave none. route_accuracy, info_reference_subset_pass_rate, info_expected_filters_pass_rate, booking_expected_search_pass_rate, and booking_no_unexpected_failure_rate were 1.0 in all three runs. booking_tool_errors is 0.9919 because case_0121's first proposal used the wrong year for a date given without one, was refused with that message, and was retried with the right year, in all three runs; case_0164 did the same in one run. booking.txt already states how to resolve a missing year; the refusal-and-retry recovers the right booking, so this was left as is. booking_expected_search_pass_rate is scored over 28 labeled cases, one fewer than the 237-case baseline counted. judge_consumer_quality and judge_grounding_faithfulness misses were single sub-5 scores in runs 1 and 2. booking_no_unbacked_success_claims stays at 1.0; the evaluator accepts a confirm made on the same turn or any earlier turn as backing for a success claim. Run after a Python package update. Thresholds were left unchanged from the 237-case baseline.
